```yaml
name: Pre-Checkout Cleanup

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  cleanup:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux]
    steps:
      - name: Pre-Checkout Cleanup
        run: |
          echo "Cleaning up Docker containers and images..."
          docker container prune -f || true
          docker image prune -f || true
          echo "Cleanup complete."
        shell: bash
```
